title: Comparing, and how long
label: ch:gu-comparing-and-how-long
canDo: I can compare two things (X Y kartā̃ moṭũ che), say what is most (sauthī), say how long and since when (be varasthī, savārthī sā̃j sudhī), name the seasons with ṛtu, and read and write ૌ and ઋ.
